plugins.name: mida-so
plugins.description: Run A/B tests and personalizations on your own website with Mida. Create experiments and goals, generate preview URLs, read results with Mida's statistics, conclude tests, and serve winners. Two skills cover picking the right project, reading Bayesian vs. frequentist results, and the order of operations that keeps a test's data clean.

skills.name: mida-experiments
skills.description: Build and launch a Mida A/B test end to end: writing the hypothesis, creating the experiment and its variants, attaching a goal, previewing the variant before it goes live, launching, and deciding when there is enough data to call it. Use when the user asks to test, try, or experiment with a change to their site ("test a new headline", "try a different CTA", "does the shorter form convert better"), or to review a test someone has already set up.
headings: 1. Start from a hypothesis, not a change

skills.name: mida
skills.description: Working with Mida: A/B testing, split tests, and personalization on a live website. Use whenever "Mida" is mentioned, and as the entry point for any request to create, launch, check, pause, conclude, or roll out an experiment on a site that runs the Mida tag. Also covers reading Mida results correctly (Bayesian "chance to beat original" vs. p-value), goals and events, and the order of operations that keeps a test''s data clean.
